entries.prompt: Extract this receipt. Use ISO date YYYY-MM-DD when a date is present. Choose one category: meals, travel, office, software, services, or other. Set needs_review to True when the amount or merchant is unclear, the receipt looks duplicated, or the purchase needs a person to check. Explain an approval concern briefly in review_reason.
